entities.name: Clan Umezawa
entities.description: A family from the Empire of Madara on Dominaria, originating on Kamigawa; symbol is the Phoenix crest.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: First known named member of the clan; a rogue blinded and exiled to Dominaria who founded Umezawa Manor.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A Kamigawan god whose order Toshiro disobeyed.

entities.name: Chanto Umezawa
entities.description: A farmer drafted into the Kentsu who became a sword maker.

entities.name: Haki Umezawa
entities.description: Chanto's son, who lost an eye in a formal duel.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion of Madara who destroyed Ramses Overdark and Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A vicious god-emperor who invaded the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Tetsuo's nemesis, made imperial regent by Bolas.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: A modern-day descendant who uses magical doorways and plots against Bolas.

entities.name: Satoru
entities.description: Leader of the Hyozan Reckoners who claims descent from Toshiro Umezawa.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A group on Kamigawa led by Satoru.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: The Dominarian empire where the Umezawa live.

events.summary: Toshiro disobeys the Myojin of Night's Reach and is blinded and exiled to Dominaria.
events.quote: he was blinded and exiled to Dominaria as punishment
He founded the Clan’s ancestral home, Umezawa Manor

events.summary: Chanto is drafted into the Kentsu and later becomes a successful sword maker.
events.quote: he became a successful sword maker

events.summary: Tetsuo renounces the title of imperial champion after Bolas makes Overdark regent, swears vengeance and destroys both Overdark and Bolas.
events.quote: He swore vengeance and destroyed both Overdark and Bolas.
